# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server: a brush model mover pushing and carrying a player.
# map mp_carentan, gametype dm (served as probe_ride), one client joined allies.
# Two shells, the gsc probe first, then the client:
#   COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> PORT=29131 SECS=115 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_ride mp_carentan +set probe_teleport 1
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --net-probe 127.0.0.1:29131 --probe-ride --probe-team allies --probe-secs 104
# probe_ride.gsc keeps the bombzone_A brush model *5 (entity 177) linked under dm,
# stands the player on its plank slab and moves it one verb per phase, then links
# the player to a script_origin and moves that. docs/research/cod11-movers.md,
# sections 11 to 13, is what it measured.
# This file is the server half, games_mp.log's PROBE lines: per server frame of a
# phase, `PROBE f <phase> <level time> <player origin> <mover getorigin()> <mover .angles>`.
